thesis: NEAR captures agent value through Intents-funded buybacks, not gas.
method: 80% intervals = 10th-90th percentile of 79 rolling 12-day windows over the last 90 days (DefiLlama). P5: the same over 67 rolling 12-day balance changes of buybacks.multisignature.near (first block of each UTC day, archival RPC), leaving out the windows with a day above 200,000 NEAR (a one-off: 502,793 NEAR from a DAO on 2026-09-09).
evaluation: On or after 2026-11-14 (UTC), fetch the same sources (below), keep the UTC days 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-12 inclusive present in all four series. P1 = mean of daily volume. P2 = sum(Intents revenue) / sum(NEAR gas fees). P3 = 10000 * sum(Intents revenue) / sum(volume). On chain, B(day) = amount + locked of buybacks.multisignature.near (view_account) at the first block at or after 00:00 UTC of that day, on an archival RPC. P5 = B(2026-11-13) - B(2026-11-01), in NEAR. P6 = the largest fall of B from one day to the next, 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-13. A prediction is TRUE if the observed value lies in its interval (P3: at or above its minimum; P6: at most 1 NEAR), FALSE otherwise. Fewer than 12 days: no verdict.
caveats: DefiLlama 'revenue' (equal to 'holdersRevenue') for near-intents is the NEAR sent to three wallets: buybacks.multisignature.near, fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near (a front-end fund DAO) and 1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near. Over the 30 days to 2026-10-30 the buyback multisig received 65.6% of it (on-chain balance changes).

Bought-back NEAR offsets emission only if it is burnt or locked. On 2026-10-30 buybacks.multisignature.near held 2.13M NEAR, none staked or locked, movable by 2 of its 4 keys: it offset nothing yet. P5 and P6 read that account on chain.

P2.metric: Intents revenue / NEAR gas fees (total, not only the burnt share)

P3.metric: protocol take rate = Intents revenue / volume (bp)

P5.metric: NEAR received by buybacks.multisignature.near over the window (balance change)

P6.metric: largest daily fall of the buybacks.multisignature.near balance (NEAR): the bought NEAR is not sent out
